item.title: Apple Introduces Home View Hub at Welcome Home Event
item.description: Apple's Home View smart‑home hub, announced for October 13, expands the HomePod line and aims for a November launch with deeper Siri integration.

item.title: Apple Unveils Home View & New TV 4K at Welcome Home
item.description: Apple’s Welcome Home event will debut the Home View smart display and a refreshed Apple TV 4K featuring upgraded microphones and Siri Remote this week.

item.title: Apple Home View: Siri‑Centric Smart Home Hub Unveiled
item.description: Apple’s upcoming Home View hub, a Siri‑driven display for smart homes, will launch mid‑November alongside a refreshed HomePod mini and Apple TV.
